{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Check for -1 in customer_age
total_rows = len(df)
missing_age_count = (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()
missing_age_percent = (missing_age_count / total_rows) * 100

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
qa_count = len(qa_orders)

# Check for refunded orders
refunded = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
refunded_count = len(refunded)

print(f'Total rows: {total_rows}')
print(f'Missing age (-1): {missing_age_count} ({missing_age_percent:.1f}%)')
print(f'QA orders (revenue 999999.99): {qa_count}')
print(f'Refunded orders: {refunded_count}')

# Display first few rows of QA orders
qa_orders.head()"}
